# AgentMesh Web - Bicycle Repair Portal

> An open, inspectable service portal for humans and autonomous web agents.

## Instructions for AI Agents
- Discover capabilities via `/.well-known/agent.json`.
- Query available repair services using `POST /api/agent/execute` with `{"action": "list_services"}`.
- Never submit `request_quote` without explicit human confirmation (`"human_confirmed": true`).
- Never assume human confirmation. The backend independently enforces confirmation before processing quote requests.
- Validate all inputs and handle API errors safely.
- Do not expose private user information or submit requests without authorization.

## Available Actions
- `list_services`: Retrieve available bicycle repair services and pricing.
- `request_quote`: Submit a bicycle repair quotation request after explicit human confirmation.

## Security
- Human-in-the-loop authorization.
- Server-side input validation.
- Explicit confirmation for quote requests.
